exposure: middle cerebral artery pulsatility index (MCA PI MoM)
outcome: intrapartum compromise (abnormal intrapartum fetal heart rate, intrapartum fetal scalp pH < 7.20, urgent cesarean section, neonatal pH < 7.10, Apgar score at 5 min <7)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 282 singleton pregnancies with fetuses estimated to be less than the 3rd centile, who underwent an ultrasound scan between 32+0 and 40+6 weeks and delivered after induction or spontaneous onset of labor.
finding: The cerebral Doppler, particularly MCA PI and CPR MoM combined with parity, can identify very small fetuses less likely to experience intrapartum compromise.
birth_weight: estimated weight less than the 3rd centile
